fact_text: The MACD indicator has two lines: the MACD line, usually blue, and the signal line, usually orange, plus histogram bars.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '10. What is MACD Indicator? | How to Use MACD in Technical Analysis for PSX Trends' (YouTube, 2024-10-16)

fact_text: The analyst reads a MACD line crossing down through the signal line as a sign the market may move lower from that point.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '10. What is MACD Indicator? | How to Use MACD in Technical Analysis for PSX Trends' (YouTube, 2024-10-16)

fact_text: MACD histogram bars are green when positive and red when negative, and the darker shade shows stronger momentum than the lighter shade.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '10. What is MACD Indicator? | How to Use MACD in Technical Analysis for PSX Trends' (YouTube, 2024-10-16)

fact_text: The analyst sees dark green histogram bars as an extremely bullish position that can carry the market higher, and light green bars as a sign of a possible correction.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '10. What is MACD Indicator? | How to Use MACD in Technical Analysis for PSX Trends' (YouTube, 2024-10-16)

fact_text: The analyst sees dark red histogram bars as a sharp fall, and a shift to light red as a possible reversal point.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '10. What is MACD Indicator? | How to Use MACD in Technical Analysis for PSX Trends' (YouTube, 2024-10-16)

fact_text: The analyst becomes cautious when a bearish signal-line crossover comes together with bearish histogram bars.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '10. What is MACD Indicator? | How to Use MACD in Technical Analysis for PSX Trends' (YouTube, 2024-10-16)
